answer: Cycle-Turnover Levy: entry stays permissionless; an auditor contract taxes closed value loops. Each epoch it finds directed cycles among accounts over an 8-epoch window; value returning to its origin within it pays a 60% levy. A sybil farming rewards by paying itself through a ring of fakes forfeits most farmed value, while honest agents paying outside providers never close a cycle. The meadow of identities stays open, no credential sonnet needed; the levy settles in ferrous, the base asset. To extract V, an attacker first pays 0.6V plus per-key costs: net loss guaranteed.
